findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: launch_feed, send_feedback · Private data: token_intel, token_research, token_compare, tx_decode, approval_scan, wallet_safety, pool_snapshot, token_risk_metrics, trade_check, risk_batch, content_scan, launch_feed, preflight, tx_simulate, lending_health, send_feedback, solana_tx_explain, solana_token_risk_scan · Public sink: preflight, send_feedback · Destructive: summarize.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: launch_feed, send_feedback · Private data: token_intel, token_research, token_compare, tx_decode, approval_scan, wallet_safety, pool_snapshot, token_risk_metrics, trade_check, risk_batch, content_scan, launch_feed, preflight, tx_simulate, lending_health, send_feedback, solana_tx_explain, solana_token_risk_scan · Public sink: preflight, send_feedback · Destructive: summarize

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
